configurePresets.name: project-debug
configurePresets.description: Configures this project's Game.dll build. Machine-local values stay out of this file: WE_ROOT and WE_ENGINE_BUILD_DIR come from the environment when set, otherwise the project resolves .we/engine-root.txt / the relative layout, and a complete <engine>/build/x64-Debug is picked up automatically (fast path).

configurePresets.name: project-release
configurePresets.description: Release configuration. It uses the fast path only when the engine also has build/x64-Release built; otherwise it falls back to building the engine from source (slow on the first run).
